- a SyntaxError logs only 'corrupt ledger (SyntaxError)', NEVER error.message;
- anything else logs error?.message ?? error as now (keep wtRoot in the second one).
Keep `return null;`. If the file already has a helper for the cap-raise path's 'corrupt file (SyntaxError)' masking, reuse the same wording. Change nothing else.

Then run: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test the tests that import project-commands (grep tests/ for project-commands) and confirm green. One-line summary.
